## Cell/face-consistent reference (`SNAP_WB_REF4`) {#sec-ch12-wb-reference}

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default: **off**. Enable the fourth-order reference with `SNAP_WB_REF4=1`; centroid conversion also enables it.
With nonzero radial gravity, setup requires at least three ghost cells. The filter preserves cubics on a uniform grid;
this algebraic order is not a measured solver convergence rate. The defining filter is @eq-ch12-wb-reference-filter.
:::

### Derivation

Let $\chi=\rho/p$ in $\mathrm{s^2\,m^{-2}}$. Taylor expansion of $\chi(x_{1,i}+l h)$,
with integer offset $l$, gives one term for each weighted moment. For weights
$(-1,4,10,4,-1)/16$, the zeroth moment is one and the first three moments vanish.
The fourth moment is $-3/2$, so the leading smooth error is $-h^4\partial_1^4\chi/16$.
The cell reference is therefore

$$
\rho_{\mathrm{ref},i}=p_{\mathrm{ref},i}
\frac{-\chi_{i-2}+4\chi_{i-1}+10\chi_i+4\chi_{i+1}-\chi_{i+2}}{16}.
$$ {#eq-ch12-wb-reference-filter}

`wb_ref4_cells` implements @eq-ch12-wb-reference-filter ([`wb_ref4.cpp:233-287`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/wb_ref4.cpp#L233-L287)).
Cell means have integral $h\rho_{\mathrm{ref},i}$ on a Cartesian cell. Accumulating these integrals at five faces
and differentiating their quartic interpolant returns the four-cell face rule $(-1,7,7,-1)/12$ in a uniform interior.
Thus the face density comes from the same cell field, rather than an independently averaged ratio.
At a clamped wall the missing filter values are cubic extrapolations: the first missing value has weights
$(4,-6,4,-1)$ and the second $(10,-20,15,-4)$. Substitution reproduces all cubics.
`configuration_check.py` checks both these moment identities and the face rule by exact rational integration.
Source derivation: `docs/derivations/wb-ref4.md@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0` §3–5.

### Numerical method

The filter uses five cell ratios and the face map uses four cell means. Clamped walls use owned cells only;
seams read exchanged neighbors. The pressure-drop flag is dilated by two cells, which makes its effective reach
three cells across a seam. Range or resolution failures retain the base reference. Nonuniform cell pressure uses
a cubic face interpolant. With zero gravity no radial reference is built and the ghost-depth guard is inactive.
Reference construction precedes x1 perturbation reconstruction on each hydro call.

```{python}

#| fig-cap: "Five-cell reference filter: sky-blue circles are cell ratios, black ticks are faces, and labels give filter and wall-continuation weights."
#| fig-alt: "five cells: -1,4,10,4,-1; wall: cubic continuation; cell density reference; four-cell face integral."
#| echo: false
```

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
No fitted order is measured here. Guards can lower the effective order; wall and gnomonic convergence must not be
inferred from the interior moments. The gnomonic and extra switch combinations remain gaps in @sec-ch12-matrix.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
